Recommended simpler route: A=existing E993OrderBand.marked_bound_below_even on |U|<=2k (arbitrary marks). Prove generic marked B at |U|<=2k+1 when induced G[U] has at least two edges: split on any marked w. Absent-w marked term uses A on U\{w}; present-w ordinary term on U\N[w] has <=2k-1 if w nonisolated, so elementary ordinary shadow; if w isolated it has <=2k and retains two edges, use inherited firstWide_nonpos_of_two_edges at equality. Then C at |U|=2k+2, no cover<=2 and a nonisolated marked w: absent-w family uses B since deleting w still leaves >=2 edges (otherwise w plus one edge endpoint is a cover<=2); present-w residual has <=2k, and in equality |N_U[w]|=2 its edges cannot have cover0 or1 without giving U cover<=2, hence at least2edges; otherwise ordinary shadow. A/B/C is in audited informal proof. This avoids proving a fully enumerated first-mark partition. Prove count split by an explicit insert/erase bijection and bridge induced-subtype ordinary counts to the existing Finset count definition.
Connectivity supplies a nonisolated mark: every component of T-{v,s} attaches to s. Since retained graph has an edge, in that component the unique neighbor of s along a shortest path is a mark with a retained neighbor. Could instead prove all marks isolated implies retained edgeless via tree connectedness/reachability. Retained_has_edge alone is insufficient. Existing no_two_cover_retained and leaf_term_eq_tagged_delta/aggregate_nonpos_of_marked_shadows finish tree and aggregate bridges. Use only the controller-provided file bridge, not direct shell/SSH Lean builds. Write Candidate.lean in own scratch and call python3 lean_bridge_client.py UNIQUE_ID compile Candidate.lean (IDs begin c3q to distinguish earlier attempts). read_mathlib and search_mathlib are supported. No axioms, sorry, admit, native_decide, unsafe/meta execution, fake theorem, or source edits outside scratch. Finish by writing BRIDGE-STOP.
